blocks.text: SANA INTERVIEW PAGE 4
Question: Solid advice! Let’s talk a bit more about your streams. Firstly, the movie you put out for your debut stream was all kinds of crazy. How long did it take to develop and create it?
Answer: Around three days I think.
Question: What were some of your most memorable streaming moments?

Answer: There are too many memorable moments to count! Like the time we gave birth to a horse and showed it to Yagoo, the time I caught a shiny Rayquaza, the longest collab in the history of hololive until then, the time on Opposite Day where I had a strange lapse in my memory for some reason, the time I became a worm… But the most memorable one for me has to be the Beegsmol stream. It took so much time and effort behind the scenes to set it up but seeing everything come together and everybody having fun with my cute and round designs is something I definitely won’t ever forget.

Question: What an amazing stream that was, packed full of fun and emotion. Everyone can agree that it will be one to be deeply cherished and remembered. Looking back on the days not too long since your debut, were there any other fond memories or impressions of that time?
Answer: One memory that stuck with me was the time I celebrated the start of channel monetization.

On my very first superchat-enabled stream I didn’t think I was gonna get a whole lot of superchats so I bought a ton of party poppers to pop every time somebody did. I didn’t expect the number that I eventually got, and became so inundated by them that I couldn’t keep up and I ended up with a room full of confetti.

Question: That was pretty crazy, yes! The Sanallites were out in full force to shower you with love and support that day. Was there any other viewer interaction that has always stayed in your mind or stuck out to you?

Answer: In general, every single time I want to do something there will always be people around to keep me company. That’s what made streaming so fun for me. Whenever I say something strange on stream I’d look at chat and they’d never fail to make it even weirder. I love that.
Question: Was there any game or activity that you think was improved or made more fun by streaming it to the Sanallites?
Answer: Giving birth to a horse.

Question: …O-okay! What streams were you particularly satisfied with?
Answer: I was pretty proud of my outfit reveal! I got really technical with that and I think it really paid off.
I was also really proud of the CouncilRys April Fools stream relay as well because I built up the system to pull it off and the result was hilarious! All the effort I put in was worth it.
Question: We think so too! Regarding collabs, the Ender Dragon collab was crazy - but what would you say was the craziest collab you've done (if not that one)?
Answer: I like the April Fool’s relay! I like HoloMinistry, but currently the craziest one yet has to be the Beegsmol 3D collab.

Question: We can’t think of a single collab of yours that wasn’t interesting, but the Beegsmol VRC stream definitely has to be the best of them all! Besides your creative off-the-wall content, one of the other things you’re known for are incredibly long streams, how do you do it?
Answer: It’s just fun! It’s fun when you’re around people who want to be around you.
Question: Very true, but is there a particular mindset or expectation you try to reach while you're streaming?
Answer: I just have fun! I like to talk with chat and do activities together. I don’t expect anything more or anything less and always hit my mark.
Question: That’s a great hassle-free approach. You play a variety of games from Kirby to Metroid, but were there any games that you grew to like more as you played them on stream?

Answer: I already like all the games I stream! Minecraft maybe? Because hololive was the first time I ever played Minecraft. I still don’t know a lot of things about the game but playing it with all the other talents in one big server was a lot of fun.
